items.title: Verde Árido
items.subtitle: Intelligence and Sustainability in the Semiarid Region
items.context: 14th Edition of Campus Mobile — Instituto Claro / USP
items.description: Verde Árido is an Agtech platform focused on strengthening livestock farming in the Brazilian semiarid region, selected for the 14th edition of Campus Mobile. The solution addresses the technological management of forage palm and precision nutrition for livestock, aiming to reduce producers' vulnerability to drought periods. The proposal serves both rural producers directly and agricultural consulting companies, with a business model structured to scale. Through georeferencing and the democratization of data such as the Agricultural Climate Risk Zoning, the project provides accessible technical support for decision-making in the field. The core focus is keeping people on the land and fighting rural exodus.

image.alt: Verde Árido app interface showing the forage palm monitoring dashboard in the semiarid region

items.title: Guardiões da Bandeira
items.subtitle: Our childhood, turned into a game
items.context: Game Dev Quest — Paraíba Games Incentive Circuit
items.description: Guardiões da Bandeira is a mobile strategy and adventure game selected for Game Dev Quest. The project adapts the popular Brazilian game 'Pega Bandeira' (Capture the Flag) into a competitive digital environment rooted in Brazilian folklore. The interface design was built to support limited-vision mechanics and tactical movement, while keeping navigation intuitive during cooperative matches. The visual identity uses stylized 2D art referencing national culture, featuring folklore characters and special powers. The project includes a progression system, individual rankings and a soundtrack based on traditional Brazilian rhythms.

image.alt: Guardiões da Bandeira game screen showing a tactical map with Brazilian folklore characters

items.title: RePlast3D
items.subtitle: 1st Place — Intercourse Competition
items.description: Project awarded 1st place in the inter-course competition at IFPB's Technology Week. The proposal consists of transforming plastic waste generated by the institution itself into filaments for 3D printing, for use in the prototyping labs. The feasibility analysis was recognized by the judging panel as one of the strongest points of the work, along with its potential environmental impact. The project shows how reusing materials can meet real technical demands efficiently and at low cost.

image.alt: RePlast3D project presentation showing the process of turning recycled plastic into 3D printing filament

items.title: Plot Twist Club
items.subtitle: Visual Identity
items.description: Plot Twist Club is an IFPB outreach initiative focused on democratizing access to cinema and encouraging critical thinking among public school students and the local community. With free weekly screenings and a focus on national productions, the project promotes discussions connecting films to social, historical and civic issues. I worked on the project's visual identity, including an initial proposal and a revised version.

image.alt: Plot Twist Club visual identity with graphic elements related to cinema and culture

items.title: OnDemand
items.subtitle: UI/UX Design
items.description: OnDemand is an app project focused on connecting service professionals with clients in a practical way. The work involved creating the visual identity — logo and color palette focused on conveying trust and agility — and designing the interfaces in Figma. The booking flow was designed to be simple and functional for any type of user.

image.alt: OnDemand app screens showing the service booking flow

items.title: SecureFeed
items.subtitle: Digital Security Platform
items.context: Selection Process — Loopis Junior Enterprise / Team Gamma
items.description: Digital intelligence and security platform developed as a team for Loopis Junior Enterprise's selection process. It brings together a dynamic cybersecurity news feed (via NewsAPI), a suspicious link checker integrated with Google Safe Browsing, and an interactive glossary of technical terms. The backend was built in Node.js with Express, keeping API keys secure, while the frontend uses plain HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript.

image.alt: SecureFeed platform interface showing the cybersecurity news feed and link checker

items.title: UniRota
items.subtitle: Transportation Management System
items.description: System developed in Java for the Object-Oriented Programming course. The application manages institutional transportation, allowing the registration of vehicles and drivers, route creation and organization of transit operations.

image.alt: UniRota system interface showing the route and vehicle registration panel

items.title: Consulta Climática
items.subtitle: Web app consuming a weather API
items.description: Web application for checking real-time weather information. Built for educational purposes, it demonstrates consuming external APIs with plain JavaScript — no frameworks — including error handling and a clean, responsive presentation of the data.

image.alt: Consulta Climática app screen showing temperature, humidity and weather conditions for a searched city

items.title: Pod Adm
items.subtitle: Local Management and Entrepreneurship Podcast
items.context: Final Project for the Technical Program in Administration — EEEP
items.description: Final project for the technical program in Administration, created as a team with the goal of connecting local business owners to the community of Lavras da Mangabeira (CE). Pod Adm turned conversations about management into accessible content, bringing real stories from entrepreneurs in the region. I worked on the project's identity and managed its social media (Instagram and YouTube) to expand the reach of its content.

image.alt: Pod Adm cover art with the podcast's visual identity

items.title: Smart Energy
items.subtitle: Energy Consumption Monitoring
items.description: Scientific initiation project developed during high school, which reached the state stage of Ceará Científico. The proposal was a hardware and software prototype capable of measuring the real-time energy consumption of electronic devices and, by cross-referencing the data with utility rates, converting technical readings into financial figures. The goal was to make invisible energy consumption understandable to anyone, promoting more conscious use of resources.

image.alt: Smart Energy prototype with a monitoring board plugged into an outlet and a real-time consumption display

items.title: Semana Literária
items.subtitle: Theater play and graphic design
items.description: Cultural competition among six classes, each presenting a literary work in an artistic way. My class won third place. I took part as the play's narrator and contributed to the production and graphic design of the project's communication pieces.

image.alt: Photo of the Semana Literária theater performance with the class on stage

items.title: Feira de Línguas
items.subtitle: Media management and project direction
items.context: EEEP Prof. Gustavo Augusto Lima — 1st Place
items.description: Feira de Línguas was a cultural competition among second-year classes, organized by the school's languages department. Each class presented cultural aspects creatively — covering history, cuisine, literature, dance and traditional festivities. My class won first place. I was responsible for managing the project's digital media, creating content for promotional campaigns and coordinating the platforms used to promote the event.
